summary: TORM plc filed a Form 6-K reporting its interim results for Q1 2026. The filing discloses financial results including TCE earnings of USD 286m, EBITDA of USD 201m, and net profit of USD 122m, reflecting strong operational performance. It also notes fleet renewal investments such as purchasing six MR resale vessels and delivery of LR2 and MR vessels. However, the filing is a routine earnings release, not a special situation triggering a classification under the listed categories. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is disclosed.
